coverage.method: 24 stratified barycentric points per retained triangle; weighted by retained-triangle area, an approximate display surface measure

atlasInterior.method: Closest full-source triangle point; all bilinear GEO contributors checked before disk-normalized interpolation; atlas bleed clamped to retained face.

coverage.limits: Area estimate describes the simplified displayed mesh. Atlas texel counts are not surface-area fractions. This is partial photographic coverage, not a global albedo map.

quality.definition: Bit 0 VALID required; bit 3 LOSSY explicitly permitted for visual use; all other flags rejected.

photometry.formula: D=2*cos(i)/(cos(i)+cos(e)); linear radiance divided by D before interpolation; reference D(0,0)=1.
photometry.applicationLighting: Uniform flood displays normalized imagery; Shadows applies the existing fixed-epoch Sun bank.
photometry.limitations: No phase correction, Hapke roughness correction or cast-shadow recovery. Relative display brightness, not measured albedo.

miard.reason: Direct MiARD HTTPS timed out; HTTP returned 503; the linked European Commission report attachment returned HDS-010. No original report or albedo data was inspected.

rejectedCaptures.reason: Selection was not awaited; some screenshots show the default model bank.
Hash assertion rejected a baseline file copied after the build replaced dist. The final matched capture restores the original content-addressed bank and verifies both hashes for each screenshot.

matched-capture.method: Atlas-only comparison in the same production renderer and byte-identical geometry. Old bank is intercepted from preserved pinned bytes; current bank loads normally. Every capture validates committed lens, lighting, bank hash and exact camera matrix.

conformance.json.qualification: Natural-clock browser interaction checks; no native parity claim.

visual-comparison.json.method: Atlas-only comparison in the same production renderer and byte-identical geometry. Old bank is intercepted from preserved pinned bytes; current bank loads normally. Every capture validates committed lens, lighting, bank hash and exact camera matrix.
visual-comparison.json.difference: Per-channel absolute RGB difference before the common display resize; no contrast adjustment.

integration.method: Official 67P object preparation regenerated the shared marker binding. Every already-compiled catalog transport was restored only after matching its checked-in descriptor SHA.

nativeOwnership.reason: Static closure does not observe native cameras, writes, scheduling, or resource lifetime.

integration.aggregateBoundary: Full test suite, build, 352 object/DPR cases, both navigation sequences and 13 conformance cases passed on the preceding 176-object snapshot. They were not repeated in full after adding two moons; final source/transport verification covers all 178, with package/marker/source checks and six production object/DPR cases plus 67P mosaic retention and atlas identity after integration.
